blocks.text:
After breakfast, begin a 4-hour private sightseeing tour in an air-conditioned vehicle with a professional bilingual guide.

First, see Cartagena Bay, the Pegasos pier and the Clock Tower.

The route then continues to La Candelaria Monastery on La Popa hill, which offers sweeping views of the city.

If access to La Popa is restricted, the programme allows this stop to be replaced by another attraction.

The next main stop is San Felipe de Barajas Castle, the largest colonial military structure in the Americas.

After the fortress, visit the Bóvedas artisan area and take a walk through the historic centre, with its old streets, squares and colonial buildings.

Included are private transport, an English-speaking guide, a visit to La Popa Monastery or an alternative attraction if access is restricted, admission to San Felipe, drinking water and a local medical assistance card.

Lunch and dinner are at an additional cost.

After breakfast, the whole day is free.

Explore Cartagena independently or choose an optional excursion.

**Rosario Islands: a shared day trip to San Pedro de Majagua**

The optional programme includes a shared boat trip, a welcome cocktail, lunch according to the selected plan and free time on the island.

Diving, snorkelling and a visit to the oceanarium are available at an additional cost.

Dinner is not included.
